value.description: Numeric value for gauge to display

secondaryValue.description: Optional secondary value for gauge to display on a second axis

startAngle.description: Radial position for start of gauge's axis

endAngle.description: Radial position for end of gauge's axis

backgroundColor.description: Color to apply as background within the gauge

animate.description: Whether needle should be animated in a sweeping motion when value changes

reverseScale.description: If true, gauge will reverse the direction from minValue to maxValue on its dial

data.description: Which value this axis and its needle should display

minValue.description: Minimum gauge value for this axis

maxValue.description: Maximum gauge value for this axis

width.description: Width of this axis, in pixels

percentRadius.description: Radius of this axis, as a percentage of total chart radius

start.description: Value at which this range starts

end.description: Value at which this range starts

width.description: Width of this axis, in pixels

color.description: Color to apply to this range on the dial

ranges.description: Zones defined in dial band with a unique color

origin.description: Distance from gauge's center the needle starts, as a percentage of the radius

reach.description: How far needle reaches from the center of the gauge towards the outer dial, as a percentage of the radius

color.description: Color of tick marks for this axis

thickness.description: Thickness of tick marks for this axis

length.description: Length of tick marks for this axis

variants.label: Pie Chart
variants.tooltip: A standard pie chart that displays a list of items, each of which has a value that is part (percentage) of the total.

variants.label: Flat Chart
variants.tooltip: A standard pie chart that displays a list of items, each of which has a value that is part (percentage) of the total.

variants.label: Three Dimensional
variants.tooltip: A standard pie chart that displays a list of items, each of which has a value that is part (percentage) of the total.

label.description: Name of subject of current pie section

value.description: Value which determines percentage of chart current pie section occupies

data.description: Data source for this chart. Each object within array defines the name and value for a single pie section.

items.description: Color for a single pie section

colors.description: Colors that correspond to each pie section, respective of order in data

title.description: Name to display for this chart

valueFormat.description: Label and legend value format configuration

showValueAsPercent.description: Whether to show the value as a percent of total or the raw value

showPercentSymbol.description: Whether to show the percent symbol next to the percent value

showLabels.description: Whether to show labels for each section of this chart

showName.description: Whether to show the name on the label

showValue.description: Whether to show the value on the label. Hiding values will disable any value formats set

bent.description: Bend labels around slices. Bending labels will disable the align and wrap properties

align.description: Whether the labels should be aligned in vertical columns

enabled.description: Whether the labels should show inside of the chart slices, based on if the value percentage is below the percentLimit threshold. Displaying labels inside the chart will disable bent and align properties

radius.description: Distance in percentage towards center of pie chart while inside is enabled. 0 represents outside edge while 100 would be directly in the middle

color.description: Label color for labels while they are displayed inside the chart

percentLimit.description: Value that determines at what value percentage to place label on outside of chart instead of inside

tooltipFormat.description: Value that determines the format of the tooltips.

showLegend.description: Value that determines whether to show a legend for this chart or hide it

enabled.description: Value that determines whether to show the legend icons or hide them

legendLabelColor.description: The color of the legend labels

cutoutRadius.description: Percent of total radius to cut out of center of chart. If greater than zero, chart becomes ring-style instead of pie.

selection.description: An object that contains selection related properties.

enabled.description: Enables selection of pie chart slices.

data.description: A read-only list of currently selected pie chart slice

width.description: Thickness of border around each pie section

color.description: Color of border around each pie section

opacity.description: Opacity of border around each pie section. 0 is fully transparent, 1 is fully opaque.

enableTransitions.description: Whether chart has visual transition effects for changes in chart data

threeDimensional.description: Whether chart has a depth effect to look three-dimensional

schema.title: Simple Gauge
schema.description: A simple, modern web style Gauge component

value.description: Numeric value for gauge to display

startAngle.description: Radial position for start of gauge's arc

endAngle.description: Radial position for end of gauge's arc

arc.description: Radial band that displays gauge's value

width.description: Width of the arc showing gauge's value

color.description: Color of the arc showing gauge's value

cornerRadius.description: Amount to round the edges of the arc

arcBackground.description: Background or 'track' for gauge arc. Shows shape and total potential value behind the arc.

opacity.description: Opacity of the arc background, as a number ranged 0 to 1

label.description: Displays the value as text, with optional units

size.description: Font size to display label text

offsetX.description: The x offset relative to the middle of the label.

offsetY.description: The y offset relative to the bottom of the label.

color.description: The color of the text to display.

units.description: Any unit information to append to the value on the label

maxDecimal.description: Maximum number of digits after decimal to display in the label. If null, full value will display.

animate.description: Whether gauge should be animated in a sweeping motion when value changes

variants.label: XY Chart
variants.tooltip: A chart that displays data trends.

dataSources.description: An object of data sources for this chart.

additionalProperties.description: A dataset, array of objects, or an array of arrays.

title.description: Chart title configuration, and underlying Label object.

subtitle.description: Chart subtitle configuration, and underlying Label object.

legend.description: Chart legend configuration, and underlying Legend object.

absolute.description: Used to position legend when position is absolute.

x.description: The x coordinate position relative to chart.

y.description: The y coordinate position relative to chart.

enabled.description: Enables all series markers used in legend.

mirrorLookOfSeries.description: Markers will be drawn to mirror the look of the series elements.  Important, customizing markers beyond width and height requires that this value is false.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius applied to the rectangle marker.

path.description: Shorthand path to icon source, in format: library/iconName

verticalCenter.description: The vertical anchor point for the icon.

horizontalCenter.description: The horizontal anchor point for the icon.

text.description: A template string which is applied to all labels.

cursor.description: The chart cursor configuration, and underlying XYCursor object.

enabled.description: Enables all chart cursors that are set to show.

series.description: Binds the chart cursor to the specified series' data source.

lineX.description: The chart cursor configuration for the line that intersects the x axis.

lineY.description: The chart cursor configuration for the line that intersects the y axis.

scrollBars.description: Chart scroll bar configuration, and underlying XYChartScrollbar object.

enabled.description: Enables the horizontal scroll bar on the chart.

series.description: Binds this horizontal scroll bar to a series.

enabled.description: Enables the vertical scroll bar on the chart.

series.description: Binds this vertical scroll bar to a series.

selection.description: An object containing selection related properties.

enabled.description: Enables selection of bullets, columns, and candlesticks.

data.description: a read-only list of currently selected data points

selectedHighlightColor.description: The color of a data point while actively selected

background.description: Chart background configuration, and underlying chart container background element.

rotation.description: Gradient rotation, applied only to linear gradient.

colors.description: Colors to be used with gradient.

color.description: Single color to be used as chart background if color is chosen as render mode.

series.description: An array of series configurations to apply to this chart, and underlying XYSeries object.
series.title: Series

name.description: A unique name to help identify the application of this series.

label.description: Series label to use with legend.

source.description: The name of the data source to bind to this series.

x.description: The x-value key from the specified data source to be used in this series. A string value if the data source is a dataset or an array of objects.  An index if the data source is an array of arrays.

y.description: The y-value key from the specified data source to be used in this series. A string value if the data source is a dataset or an array of objects.  An index if the data source is an array of arrays.

xAxis.description: The name of the x-axis configuration object to be used with this series.

yAxis.description: The name of the y-axis configuration object to be used with this series.

zIndex.description: Sets the series stack order relative to other series.

text.description: A format string to apply to the tooltip text. See: https://www.amcharts.com/docs/v4/concepts/formatters/formatting-strings/.

render.description: Then series render mode. Specifies the series type.

x.description: Name of the field that holds the open data for the horizontal axis.

y.description: Name of the field that holds the open data for the vertical axis.

x.description: Name of the field that holds the high data for the horizontal axis.

y.description: Name of the field that holds the high data for the vertical axis.

x.description: Name of the field that holds the open data for the horizontal axis.

y.description: Name of the field that holds the open data for the vertical axis.

connect.description: Connect the lines over empty data points?

tensionX.description: Horizontal tension setting of line as a range of 0 to 1. Used to create smooth or sharp lines. 1 meaning that the tension is very high, so the line is maximally attracted to the points it connects, hence straight line. O meaning the opposite.

tensionY.description: Vertical tension setting of line as a range of 0 to 1. Used to create smooth or sharp lines. 1 meaning that the tension is very high, so the line is maximally attracted to the points it connects, hence straight line. O meaning the opposite.

minDistance.description: Minimum distance in pixels between two adjacent points.

x.description: Name of the field that holds the open data for the horizontal axis.

y.description: Name of the field that holds the open data for the vertical axis.

connect.description: Connect the lines over empty data points?

tensionX.description: Horizontal tension setting of line as a range of 0 to 1. Used to create smooth or sharp lines. 1 meaning that the tension is very high, so the line is maximally attracted to the points it connects, hence straight line. O meaning the opposite.

tensionY.description: Vertical tension setting of line as a range of 0 to 1. Used to create smooth or sharp lines. 1 meaning that the tension is very high, so the line is maximally attracted to the points it connects, hence straight line. O meaning the opposite.

minDistance.description: Minimum distance in pixels between two adjacent points.

render.description: The type of bullet to render.

truncate.description: Truncate text if it does not fit.

hideOversized.description: Hide the label if it is too long.

text.description: Tooltip text. Can be a format string.

heatRules.description: These heat rules apply to the radius of a circular bullet.

axis.description: Chart axis configuration, an underlying AxisRenderer object.

name.description: A unique name to help identify this axis configuration object. This is required in order to configure series.

enabled.description: Enables a label drawn alongside this axis.

inversed.description: Indicates if the scale of the axis should be flipped.

render.description: Dictates the axis type to render.

category.description: Category axis configuration, applied when category is selected as this axis render mode. Groups data items in categories and allots equal space for each.
category.title: Category

break.description: Tells the category axis to remove a certain range from it's scale.

size.description: The break size as a decimal percent of the removed values.

date.description: Date axis configuration, applied when date is selected as this axis render mode. Uses data and time scale.
date.title: Date

baseInterval.description: Optionally adjusts the granularity of the time scale.  Otherwise, will adjust intelligently by default.

timeUnit.description: Specifies the base time unit to apply to this time scale.

count.description: Specifies how many time units each data item was collected.

skipEmptyPeriods.description: Removes empty time units from display. Using this feature affects performance.  Will reset the use of axis breaks if true.

range.description: Optionally adjusts the range.  Otherwise, will auto range by default.

max.description: The maximum date in this range.

min.description: The minimum date in this range.

useStrict.description: Strictly enforces start and end values.

break.description: Tells the date axis to remove a certain range from it's scale.

size.description: The break size as a decimal percent of the removed values.

inputFormat.description: Date format of axis value from dataSource.

value.description: Value axis configuration, applied when value is selected as this axis render mode.
value.title: Value

range.description: Optionally adjusts the range.  Otherwise, will auto range by default.

useStrict.description: Strictly enforces start and end values.

logarithmic.description: Use logarithmic scale. Useful if data varies greatly within the relevant series.

break.description: Tells the value axis to remove a certain range from it's scale.

size.description: The break size as a decimal percent of the removed values.

format.description: A number format string to be applied against numbers if in number rendering mode.

opposite.description: Renders this axis on the opposite side.

inside.description: Enables axis labels to be rendered inside of axis.

minDistance.description: The minimum distance between grid lines.

position.description: Defines the grids relative position within the chart. A range from 0 to 1, 0 meaning start and 1 meaning end.
